comment: Variants for .github/workflows/guest-cpu.yml (tests/guest-cpu-native.py). query: page parameters added to the base; setup: shell commands typed into the guest right after sys.boot_completed=1 (experiments only); timescale: the page's time dilation for this variant (default 8); browser_like: after settling, QEMU is slowed (cgroup cpu.max) until the guest runs the browser probe's calibration loop in this many guest seconds, as the page's guest does (about 2 at timescale 8), so that Android's timeouts fire as in the browser; launch_timeout: seconds per start. apps: what is started after the guest settled, each a cold start; how=tap is a finger tap at x,y (fractions of the screen) as the page sends it, how=start is am start. ui: the UI check after the starts. Round 8: "not responding" reports at browser speed (slow*), what keeps the guest busy after Android drew Gallery, and SwiftShader's settings (ss*, /SwiftShader.ini, which every process that draws reads from its working directory /).

setup: getprop | grep -e stack-trace -e ro.debuggable -e ro.build.type -e hide_error; settings get global debug_app
getprop | grep -e stack-trace -e ro.debuggable -e ro.build.type -e hide_error; settings get global debug_app
am set-debug-app --persistent com.android.systemui; settings get global debug_app; kill $(pidof com.android.systemui); sleep 20; pidof com.android.systemui
getprop | grep -e stack-trace -e ro.debuggable -e ro.build.type -e hide_error; settings get global debug_app
setprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-dir ''; setprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-file /proc/porty-no-traces; getprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-dir; getprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-file

mount -o remount,rw / && printf '[Quality]
TextureSampleQuality=0
MipmapQuality=0
PerspectiveCorrection=0
[Testing]
ExactColorRounding=0
' > /SwiftShader.ini; mount -o remount,ro /; cat /SwiftShader.ini; setprop ctl.restart surfaceflinger; sleep 5; echo restarted
mount -o remount,rw / && printf '[Optimization]\nOptimizationPass1=0\n' > /SwiftShader.ini; mount -o remount,ro /; cat /SwiftShader.ini; setprop ctl.restart surfaceflinger; sleep 5; echo restarted
mount -o remount,rw / && printf '[Processor]\nThreadCount=2\n' > /SwiftShader.ini; mount -o remount,ro /; cat /SwiftShader.ini; setprop ctl.restart surfaceflinger; sleep 5; echo restarted
